license_required.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in Indiana who is not licensed under this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: The state board of dentistry is established

name.quote: The state board of dentistry is established

type.quote: The board is charged with the duty of administering and enforcing the laws pertaining to the practice of dentistry and of dental hygiene.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Agency" refers to the Indiana professional licensing agency established by IC 25-1-5-3.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant must be at least twenty-two (22) years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant under this article must submit proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant has not been convicted of a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently.

degree_required.value: Graduation from a dental college recognized by the board
degree_required.quote: to procure the license, the applicant must submit to the board proof of graduation from a dental college recognized by the board

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: The board may recognize dental schools accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: Board-approved clinical/written examination
exams.notes: May not take the examination more than three times
exams.quote: Every applicant must pass an examination administered by an entity approved by the board and may not take the examination more than three (3) times.

exams.name: Law examination
exams.quote: passes the law examination administered by the board or an entity approved by the board

interval_years.quote: Biennial renewal of licenses is subject to IC 25-1-2.

required.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period.

hours_per_period.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period.

period_years.quote: "license period" means the two (2) year period beginning on March 2, 1992, and every two (2) years thereafter.

value: At least half of required minimum credit hours must be from live presentations or live workshops
No more than five credit hours per period may be from practice management courses
topical_requirements.quote: At least half of the required minimum credit hours must be from live presentations or live workshops.

available.quote: The board may issue a license upon payment of a fee, set by the board under section 13 of this chapter, to an applicant who furnishes proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant is a dentist who: (1) is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana

requirements.value: Licensed in another state or Canadian province with substantially equal requirements; practiced dentistry for at least 2 of the 3 preceding years; passes law examination; completed required continuing education hours in previous 2 years
requirements.quote: has practiced dentistry for at least two (2) of the three (3) years preceding the date of application; passes the law examination administered by the board or an entity approved by the board; has completed the required hours of continuing education in the previous two (2) years

regulatory_model.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in Indiana who is not licensed under this chapter

credential_type.quote: A person desiring to begin the practice of dentistry in Indiana shall procure from the board a license to practice dentistry in Indiana.

is_mandatory.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in Indiana who is not licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: Uses the word "dentist" or "dental surgeon", the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or other letters or titles in connection with dentistry.

scope_protection.quote: It is a Level 6 felony for a person to do any of the following: (1) Practice dentistry not being at the time a dentist duly licensed to practice as such in this state under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the article or rules adopted under it subjects a licensee to discipline
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An individual who is licensed under; and fails to comply with; this article or rules adopted under this article is subject to discipline under IC 25-1-9.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without a valid license is a Level 6 felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is a Level 6 felony for a person to do any of the following: (1) Practice dentistry not being at the time a dentist duly licensed to practice as such in this state under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, hiring, or procuring an unlicensed person to practice dentistry is a Level 6 felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ, hire, or procure one who is not duly licensed as a dentist to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, bartering, or fraudulently using dental degrees, licenses, or diplomas
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sell or barter, or offer to sell or barter, or, not being lawfully authorized so to do, issue or confer, or offer to issue or confer, any dental degree, license, or any diploma

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry under a false or misleading name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry under a false name, under a name intended to mislead the public, under the license of another person of the same name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assuming dental titles or degrees without lawful conferral
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assume the title or degree of "Bachelor of Dental Surgery", append the letters "B.D.S.", "D.D.S.", "M.D.S.", or "D.M.D.", to the person's name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as entitled to practice dentistry without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not having been licensed to practice dentistry under the laws of this state, represent that the person is entitled so to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating another at a dental examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely personate another at any examination to ascertain the preliminary professional education of candidates for dental certificates, dental degrees, or dental licenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify active patients upon retirement, discontinuation of practice, or leaving the community
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon retirement, discontinuation of practice, or moving from or leaving a community, a dentist shall: (1) notify all of the dentist's active patients in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An applicant under this article must submit proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant has not been convicted of a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently.

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following: (1) Uses the word "dentist" or "dental surgeon", the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or other letters or titles in connection with dentistry. (2) Directs and controls the treatment of patients within a place where dental services are performed... (4) Offers to evaluate, diagnose, prevent, or treat: (A) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area...
definition_quote.quote: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following

value: Evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area using nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures
Extraction of human teeth or correction of malpositions of the teeth or jaws
Use of x-ray images for dental diagnostic purposes
Making oral images, impressions, or casts for prosthetic devices
Fabrication, repair, or adjustment of prosthetic dentures, bridges, or appliances
methods_authorized.quote: Offers to evaluate, diagnose, prevent, or treat: (A) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area... using nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures.

drug_authority.value: Licensed pharmacists may fill prescriptions of licensed dentists for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry; dentists may prescribe controlled substances subject to INSPECT program requirements
drug_authority.quote: Licensed pharmacists of this state may fill prescriptions of licensed dentists of this state for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry.

value: moderate sedation using a parenteral route of administration
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A dentist must have a permit to administer: (1) general anesthesia/deep sedation; or (2) moderate sedation using a parenteral route of administration; to a patient.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: The board shall establish the requirements for a program of education and training for pediatric anesthesiology.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a licensed dentist is physically present in the facility when patient care is provided by the dental hygienist. "Prescriptive supervision" means that a licensed dentist is not required to be physically present in the facility when patient care is provided by the dental hygienist if:

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "access practice agreement" means an agreement that: (1) is entered into by a licensed dentist and a dental hygienist that allows the dental hygienist to provide preventive dental hygiene services directly to a patient

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist who meets the following requirements may provide preventive dental hygiene services directly to a patient without a prior examination, presence, or authorization of the access practice dentist

value: Settings other than a private dental practice allowed under an access practice agreement
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: Settings, other than a private dental practice, allowed under an access practice agreement that complies with the requirements under IC 25-13-3.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Directs or controls the use of dental equipment or dental material while the equipment or material is being used to provide dental services.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: "INSPECT program" means the Indiana scheduled prescription electronic collection and tracking program established by IC 25-1-13-4.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A written work authorization shall include the following: (1) The name and address of the dental laboratory to which it is directed. (2) The case identification. (3) A specification of the materials to be used.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Each denture and each partial denture covered by section 2 or 3 of this chapter shall be marked with the patient's name.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: a licensed dental hygienist may administer local dental anesthetics under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist under IC 25-14 if the dental hygienist has: (1) completed board approved educational requirements, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation and emergency care training; and (2) received a board issued dental hygiene anesthetic permit.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist or dental assistant (as defined in IC 25-14-1-1.5(4)) may administer nitrous oxide under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist if the dental hygienist or dental assistant has: (1) been employed in a dental practice for at least one (1) year or has graduated from a program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association; (2) satisfactorily completed a three (3) hour didactic nitrous oxide administration course

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: completed board approved educational requirements, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation and emergency care training

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Settings, other than a private dental practice, allowed under an access practice agreement that complies with the requirements under IC 25-13-3.
